packageRules.description: Version format is {psql_major}.{psql_minor}-{ext_major}.{ext_minor}.{ext_patch} (e.g. 18.1-1.0.0). Regex maps: major=psql_major, minor=psql_minor, patch=ext_major, build=ext_minor, revision=ext_patch. This ensures both psql and extension versions are compared and bare tags (e.g. 18.2) are ignored.
